description: Georgia O'Keeffe walking out of pontoons with help of Marshall Gerard and Eliot Porter, Doris Bry, Kenny Ross, and others. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River'.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Exiting Raft
